```{r}
library('tidyverse')
library('gtExtras')
```

```{r}
library('GWalkR')
GWalkR(iris)
```

```{r}
library('caret')
set.seed(123)
trainIndex <- createDataPartition(iris$Species,p=0.8,list= FALSE)
train_data <- iris[trainIndex, ]
test <- iris[-trainIndex, ]

```

```{r}
nrow(train_data)
```

```{r}
nrow(test)
```

## Decision Trees

```{r}
dt_model <- train(Species ~ .,data = train_data, method = "rpart")
#printing the model
print(dt_model)
#make predictions
dt_predictions <- predict(dt_model,test)
#Model Evaluation
confusionMatrix(dt_predictions,test$Species)
```

## Random Forest

```{r}
#Training a Random Forest Model
rf_model <- train(Species ~ .,data = train_data,method="rf")
#printing our model
print(rf_model)
#predicting data using our model
rf_prediction <- predict(rf_model,test)
#Model Evaluation
confusionMatrix(rf_prediction,test$Species)

```

### Support Vector Machine

```{r}
svm_model <- train(Species ~.,data=train_data,method="svmRadial")
#printing the model
print(svm_model)
#predicting our test data
rf_prediction <- predict(svm_model,test)
# Model Evaluation using the Confusion Matrix
confusionMatrix(rf_prediction,test$Species)
```

### HyperParameter Tuning for Random Forest

```{r}
rf_grid <- expand.grid(mtry=c(2,3,4))
rf_model_tuned <- train(Species ~.,data= train_data,method="rf",tuneGrid=rf_grid)
#printing our model
print(rf_model_tuned)
#predicting our test data
rf_tuned_prediction <- predict(rf_model_tuned,test)
#Model evaluation using the Confusion Matrix
confusionMatrix(test$Species,rf_tuned_prediction)
```

```{r}
library(rpart.plot)
rpart.plot(dt_model$finalModel)
```

```{r}
library("randomForest")
varImpPlot(rf_model_tuned$finalModel)
```
